mapper.sql: select s.scheme_id, s.scheme_name, s.social_type, s.effective_date, s.status, s.version, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, (select count(1) from sys_salary_scheme_item si where si.scheme_id = s.scheme_id) as item_count, (select count(distinct us.user_id) from sys_user_salary_scheme us where us.scheme_id = s.scheme_id) as role_count from sys_salary_scheme s
mapper.select: where s.status = '0' order by s.effective_date desc, s.scheme_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_salary_scheme ( scheme_name, social_type, effective_date, status, version, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{schemeName}, #{socialType}, #{effectiveDate}, #{status}, 1, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
